name: qbeta-m1-rotated-index-from-blocks
description: Route C M1: S+_11(x;q) computed from the q-Hahn Bessel holomorphic blocks (GGM eq 127a/b) and checked against the printed eq (200) Laurent-in-x coefficients, plus the x=1 eq-(61) tower.

parameters.source: GGM 2012.00062v3: eq (18) fugacity basis, eq (21) dictionary, eq (127a/b) q-Hahn Bessel blocks, eq (200) explicit S+_11

data.verdict: M1 PARTIAL — one localized discrepancy at q^1, everything else exact. MATCHES: q^0 = 1; q^2 = -(x^-2 + 2x^-1 + 3 + 2x + x^2) EXACTLY; and the x=1 specialisation gives the eq-(61) tower [1,-8,-9] EXACTLY. DIFFERS: the q^1 x-distribution — computed -(x^-2 + 2x^-1 + 2 + 2x + x^2) vs printed -(2x^-2 + x^-1 + 2 + x + 2x^2). Both sum to -8 at x=1, so the discrepancy is purely how the weight is distributed over the fugacity, not its total. PROVENANCE CHECKED: the printed reading was re-extracted from the PDF at SPAN level (font-size 8 = superscript), confirming both the eq-(200) block arguments J(x,x^-1;q)J(x,x^-1;q^-1) + J(x^-2,x^-1;q)J(x^2,x;q^-1) — which this probe implements exactly — and the printed coefficient itself; so the difference is NOT a text-extraction artifact. Two live explanations, NOT adjudicated here: (a) a typo in the paper's q^1 coefficient (note q^2 is the palindromic (1,2,3,2,1) and the computed q^1 is the analogous (1,2,2,2,1), whereas the printed (2,1,2,1,2) breaks that pattern), or (b) a subtlety in the |q|<1 vs |q|>1 branch convention for J(.;q^-1) that affects this order. DELIBERATELY NOT TUNED. Resolving it needs an independent computation of I_{4_1}(0,e) in the flux basis (bean qou-m1fx).
